scope: Autoencoder of six independent DSGE consumption-response features; not a policy solver or hardness proof

teacher.utility: six separate log-utility economies, equal log weights, no transfers

data.sparse_test: independent Bernoulli probability 0.05 for each feature
data.pair_test: two distinct uniformly chosen features; distribution shift

training.initialization: independent normal matrices, standard deviation 0.4; zero decoder bias
training.loss: mean squared error across six features

interventions: Add/remove Wenc[:,i]*delta then decode; compare with actual input edit. Linear encoding equality is an algebra check, not mechanism discovery. Measure decoded error and unaffected-output leakage for isolated and singleton contexts.
baseline: TRAIN-centered best rank-2 PCA reconstructed then clipped nonnegative; coordinate reference retains two largest TRAIN second-moment coordinates
